# OmniSwitch Competitive Comparison

This table is rendered from `docs/comparison/claims.yaml`, the single source of truth for every capability claim OmniSwitch makes about itself or a competitor. See `docs/comparison/README.md` for the review process. Do not edit this file by hand.

Last verified: 2026-09-11.

Status legend: **Yes** = confirmed capability, **Partial** = capability exists with meaningful gaps or scope limits (see Detail), **No** = confirmed absent, **Unknown** = not independently verified in available sources (never treated as a claim of absence).

## In-harness gateways

Self-hosted, open-source gateways that run (or are intended to run) in the same-host benchmark harness under `bench/`. `envoy-ai-gateway` is Kubernetes-native and is deferred from the loopback harness (see `bench/README.md`).
